card.name: Small linking words in web text
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as to, from, of, a, for and commas, in general web text about networks and search engines. They sit right after a verb or phrase and before its object.

modes.label: Preposition after connection verb
modes.description: The word 'to' or 'from' follows a verb like connected, coupled or taken.

modes.label: Joining word in a clause
modes.description: A comma, 'order', 'of' or 'a' sits inside a set phrase in the middle of a sentence.
